 The opportunity
 Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.
 Day-to-day Responsibilities
Validate end-to-end business processes across the fraud lifecycle (detection, investigation, disposition, reporting) in multiple regional configurations
Perform ad-hoc exploratory testing to uncover edge cases and improve test coverage in complex, high-velocity environments
Support automation testers in analysis and solution of new automation test cases based on manual test cases
Design, execute, and document manual test cases, test plans, and test strategies for fraud detection workflows, including admission, rule-based scoring, anomaly detection, escalation, and case management
Particpate in writing Acceptance criteria on different levels
Collaborate with QA automation engineers to identify automation testing gaps and assist in creating robust automated regression suites when appropriate
Validate data integrity, reconciliation, and processing accuracy across components
Assess non-functional requirements: performance, reliability, scalability, security, and accessibility considerations
Create and maintain defect reports with clear repro steps, expected vs. actual results, severity, and traceability to requirements.
 Who Are We Looking For
Final degree (university or technical college) in software testing, software engineering or equivalent education
4+ years of hands-on manual testing experience in financial services or fraud/anti-fraud domains, preferably with high-volume transaction processing
Strong ability to create and maintain comprehensive test cases, test plans, and defect reports.
Good knowledge with test data management in data centric systems
Experience in non-functional requirement testing (performance, reliability, scalability, security, etc.)
Certifications related to software testing (ISTQB, CTFL) are a major plus
Knowledge in Test Automation is a major plus
Good practical experience in working with JIRA
Comfortable with agile approaches
Experience in fraud detection systems or Payment business is a major plus
English business fluent
